title: Purpose in Life
subtitle: How purpose in life supports long-term resilience, health, and sustainable behavior.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the association of purpose in life with improved resilience and health outcomes through multi-level psychological and physiological mechanisms. Moderate evidence exists concerning randomized interventions targeting purpose, with emerging research needed to clarify causal pathways and culture-specific influences.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
